title: Divide Array Into Equal Pairs
description:
You are given an integer array nums of size 2n.

Task

Determine whether it is possible to divide the array into exactly n pairs such that:

Each element is used exactly once
Both elements in every pair are equal

Return true if such a division is possible, otherwise return false.

Examples

Example 1
Input: nums = [3,2,3,2,2,2]
Output: true

Explanation:
Possible pairs → (2,2), (3,3), (2,2)

Example 2
Input: nums = [1,2,3,4]
Output: false

Explanation:
No way to form equal pairs.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
